description: Tracks room lifecycle states, dirty reasons, stability counters, candidate/commit blockers, and publication diagnostics.
current_role: Main-path room stabilization, commit gating, and publication-state tracking.
notes: Real runtime machinery, but not a rebirth matcher.

description: Commits rooms that satisfy lifecycle conditions and exports committed/public topology, world model, and snapshot artifacts.
current_role: Main-path commit/public projection and bounded local-plus-committed memory.
notes: Uses accepted room IDs; does not restore old IDs onto new births.

description: Carries room IDs forward by mask IoU and retains missing rooms for a bounded `tracking_missed_cycles` window.
current_role: Short-window room-ID continuity during segmentation refreshes.

description: Maps per-floor local room IDs into a world-room namespace through `local_to_world_room_id`.
notes: This is ID translation, not rebirth handling.

description: Treats a room as leave-like when it is no longer active and either has a departed frame or enough stable export observations.
notes: Important for lifecycle/publication, not for identity persistence.

description: Hashes quantized room geometry and metadata and tracks stability counts across exports.
notes: Looks identity-related, but current use is stability only.

description: Hashes per-room gateway structure and counts stable refreshes.
Hashes object/anchor containment per room and tracks stability counts.
notes: Not currently used to reconnect a new room to an old dropped room.

description: Uses floor status, room-floor validation, and vertical-transition completeness as commit/publication blockers.
evidence: `boxfusion/online_topology_lifecycle.py:1046-1061`; vector-map floor validation and vertical-transition summaries come from `boxfusion/floor_aware_room_segmenter.py:577-620`.
notes: Important lifecycle blockers, but not identity persistence.

description: Builds adjacency, transition, and vertical-transition evidence from gateways, polygon proximity, and transition history.
notes: Useful future hook; not a rebirth matcher today.

mechanism_or_signal: Committed room world model summaries and stable_room_id field
description: Exports committed room summaries, object composition, connectivity, and a `stable_room_id` field equal to the committed room ID.
notes: This is an export hook, not a separate identity-restoration mechanism.

description: Ranks committed rooms by adjacency, same-floor status, and distance for bounded local fusion context.
current_role: Retrieval context for local runtime fusion.
notes: Potentially useful for future rebirth logic, but not used that way now.

description: Marks a room revisitable when the same room ID is observed again after departure.
notes: Assumes identity was already preserved; it does not recover a lost identity.

description: No runtime code was found that matches a newly created room back to a previously dropped room using signatures, summaries, topology, or containment.
evidence: Negative evidence from inspected runtime files: signatures are used for stability (`online_topology_lifecycle.py:524-560`), export cache (`floor_aware_room_segmenter.py:1098-1185`), and summaries/retrieval (`room_scoped_runtime.py:390-458`, `559-607`).
notes: Direct answer to the rebirth question is no.

mechanism_or_signal: Implicit rebirth-like continuity via same-ID survival
description: A room can appear persistent if IoU tracking keeps the same ID alive or if it survives brief absence within `tracking_missed_cycles`.
current_role: Bounded continuity while the same room ID survives.
notes: Stops short of true rebirth once the old ID is gone.

description: Uses pose proximity and room re-entry heuristics to emit revisit events during recording.
notes: Not used to change authoritative room identity.

description: Builds debug artifacts that explain withheld rooms, blocker evolution, and commit/publication gaps.
notes: Important for diagnosis, not for identity persistence.

description: Offline/debug-room studies measure birth support, persistence proxies, and local fragmentation behavior.
current_role: Analysis tooling for segmentation stability studies.
notes: These studies exist, but they do not implement runtime rebirth.

mechanism_or_signal: Segmenter self-report: no online leave signal / no incremental online topology
description: The segmenter explicitly reports no room leave signal and no incremental online topology trigger structures; updates happen on scheduled segmentation refresh plus full rebuild.
current_role: Explicit statement of current lifecycle/topology limits.
notes: Important guardrail against overstating online lifecycle sophistication inside the segmenter itself.
